certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control general 
director & MPIS coordinator.

Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures 
P1, 
which should be carried out every three years as indicated by Y3 in the title 
block.
The technical specification of the hydro unit: 
Francis Turbine max. power 180MW, max head 75m, speed 100 RPM, Woodward 
governor.
The first draft 
was initiated by eng. Mohamed Abd Allah Ismaiel, tested by eng. Atef Sadeq 
Sayed, accepted by eng. Ahmed Saber Gabr: general director, approved by eng. 
Abdel-Karem Abuaid: head sector of High Dam power station, and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control general 
director & MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, 
 safety glass ... etc
Completely 
 empty the tunnel.
Water level 
 at draft tube not exceed 100m.
Secure 
 closing intake and draft tubes maintenance gates.
Open the 
 wicket gates to100%.
Switch off 
 F403 automatic.
Close the 
 main oil valve no.7.
Release 
 pressure of the oil pressure unit MHY to zero.
Use overhead 
 crane 400 ton.
Use the 
 lightening 36 Volt
Use 8 bar 
 service air.
Tools and Equipment
Set of common and special wrenches
Spare parts, gaskets and rubber.
Benzene, kerosene, cleaning material (rags, cloth)
Grinding paper.
Scrapers.
Wire brushes.
Sealing rubber.
Set of different size bolts.
Filler gauge.
Silicon sealant.
